data.value: Build up four foundations by suit from Ace to King.
Any card on the table can be moved to the card which is one higher and has alternative color.
You can move the entire pile to another pile as long as it is in descending order and alternating color.
Any empty pile can be filled with any card, or a pile of cards.
Deal 1 or 3 cards. Play cards to the table or foundations. You can flip through the deck infinitely.
